A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 24-page versions of the same R3 paper. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A.1–A.7 support reliable comparison; all appendix pages are unchanged.

before.justification: v1 reports original R3 generation and understanding evaluations, ablations, training curves, computational measurements, and qualitative examples, including appendix maze-navigation results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the generation and ITA/VQA evaluations, ablations, computational measurements, and appendix demonstrations.

M1.justification: The Reason-Reflect-Refine procedure, BAGEL foundation, Tree-RL strategy, stage-wise rewards, and GRPO/FlowGRPO training remain unchanged. The maze-navigation adaptation in Appendix A.7 is also identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use GenEval, GenEval++, TIIF, compositional VQA, ITA, and the appendix maze-navigation scenario. The newly cited Genius evaluation suite is not added to the experiments.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding comparisons, including Tables 1, 6, 8, and 9. Neither newly cited work is introduced as an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Sections 3 and A.3 and Table 7 retain the same data construction, splits, evaluation models, metrics, training budgets, trajectory settings, and sampling procedures.

E4.justification: The trajectory-length ablations, training-evolution analysis, cross-topic evaluation, RL-training ablation, computational-cost analysis, and qualitative success/failure examples are all retained without revision.

E5.justification: No repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty-estimation procedures, or significance tests are added or revised. Figure 4 retains the same shaded training-reward curves and caption.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout, including the appendices. For example, R3 retains 0.689 on GenEval++ (Table 1), 73.37% ITA accuracy (Table 2), 89.63% VQA accuracy (Table 3), and 82.02 overall on TIIF (Table 6).

T1.justification: The probabilistic formulation, Markovian assumption, reward definitions in Equations 1–3, and GRPO/FlowGRPO mathematical development in Appendix A.2 are identical. No mathematical definitions, derivations, or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about mitigating the generation–understanding conflict through R3. The added Section 4 wording about improving both capabilities simultaneously restates an existing aim.

C2.justification: The optimization-conflict explanation and interpretations of co-evolution remain unchanged. Both versions retain the domain-specific generalization limitation in Section 3.2 and the premature-termination failure illustrated in Figure 11.

D1.justification: Appendix A.3 implementation details, Table 7 hyperparameters, Appendix A.5 hardware and latency information, and the code-availability statement are unchanged. No reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: v2 adds An et al. (2026), Genius, to the introduction's discussion of visual-understanding difficulties, and An et al. (2025), UniCTokens, to Section 4's discussion of jointly improving understanding and generation. Both bibliography entries are new; existing references and the overall research positioning are retained.

P1.justification: Section 4 gains a short clause explicitly restating simultaneous improvement of generation and understanding, accompanied by the new citations. The arXiv version/date stamp changes, while the section order and broader narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: The additions cause local text reflow on pages 1 and 9 and redistribute existing bibliography entries across pages 11–13. Figures 1–16 and Tables 1–9 retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: The two added citations modestly broaden acknowledgment of related work, but the new Section 4 clause repeats an existing aim without developing the comparison further. Methods, empirical evidence, mathematical details, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, so the update does not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
